subject: flying fox
title: The Heaviest Bat on Earth Has 5-Foot Wings and Never Eats Insects

scenes.text: The world's heaviest bat has wings about as wide as you are tall.
The giant golden-crowned flying fox of the Philippines spreads its wings up to about five and a half feet.
It weighs up to about two and a half pounds, more than any other bat.
And it never hunts insects or drinks blood. It eats mostly figs.
Each night it flies miles from its roost, dropping seeds that grow new forest.
The scariest-looking bat is the one that plants trees.

description:
The giant golden-crowned flying fox of the Philippines has a wingspan of about 1.5 to 1.7 meters and weighs up to about 1.2 kg, likely the heaviest bat on Earth.
It feeds mostly on figs and spreads their seeds as it flies to feed each night; it is endangered, with roughly 10,000 left.
Would you be scared or amazed to see one fly over?
first_comment: A bat with wings wider than you are tall. Would you hold one?
